name: Virag 3D Campaign Creative Library
principles: CURRENT BRIEF ONLY: use the current composer text and current uploads. Never import an older campaign, festival, offer, headline, product story or topic unless the user explicitly references it.
CAMPAIGN CGI FIRST: every preset should feel like a finished Pinterest/agency advertising concept, not a technical demo, plain packshot, generic pedestal render or random material test.
ONE OUTPUT = ONE STANDALONE STATIC CREATIVE. Never create a collage, contact sheet, storyboard, multi-panel composition or video unless explicitly requested.

STRICT PRODUCT ACCURACY: preserve visible product/package geometry, height-to-width proportions, cap/lid, label placement, logo, artwork, colors and distinctive details. Do not stretch, redesign or recolor the supplied product.

FRESH ART DIRECTION: same preset means the same creative mechanism, not the same layout. Change composition, hero scale, camera, environment, depth, typography, lighting, props and visual story between runs.

COMMERCIAL READABILITY: create one memorable visual idea, strong hierarchy and mobile-first readability. Add short campaign typography only when useful; never invent factual claims, prices, offers, certifications, nutrition, specs or performance claims.
PHYSICAL BELIEVABILITY: even surreal ideas need coherent perspective, contact, scale cues, materials, reflections, shadows, atmospheric depth and environmental lighting.
BRAND FIT OVER HOUSE STYLE: infer colors, materials, mood and world-building from the current product/brand/category. Do not force dark, neon, chrome, smoke or sci-fi aesthetics onto every product.
DEFAULT SOCIAL FORMAT: when no format is specified, compose as a premium 4:5 advertising creative with room for a concise headline; respect any explicitly selected format instead.

commands.label: Campaign CGI Hero
commands.desc: Flagship static CGI ad built around one memorable product idea.
commands.instruction: Create one flagship static CGI campaign creative from the current product/brief. Build a memorable advertising idea around the exact product rather than placing it on a pedestal. Use deliberate scale, depth, brand-fit environment, commercial lighting and strong 2–3 second hierarchy.

commands.label: Product Universe 3D
commands.desc: Layered foreground/midground/background brand world around the product.
commands.instruction: Create one static Product Universe 3D campaign. Build distinct foreground, midground and background depth around the exact hero product using category-relevant objects, translucent layers, architecture or environmental forms. Make the world feel intentionally designed for this brand, not like random floating decoration.

commands.label: Product as Building
commands.desc: Transform product silhouette into a believable branded store or structure.
commands.instruction: Create one static CGI campaign where the current product becomes the visual basis of a real architectural structure, kiosk, cafe, store or pavilion. Preserve the recognizable product silhouette and branding while integrating doors, windows, people and street-scale details believably. The concept should read immediately as product-as-architecture.

commands.label: Giant Product in City
commands.desc: Monumental product integrated naturally into a real-world urban scene.
commands.instruction: Create one static giant-product CGI campaign in a believable real-world urban setting. Make the exact product monumental, with convincing perspective, street scale, people/vehicles where useful, contact shadows, reflections and atmospheric depth. The product must feel physically present rather than pasted in.

commands.label: Product in Nature
commands.desc: Product becomes part of a cinematic natural landscape or journey.
commands.instruction: Create one static campaign integrating the exact product into a premium natural landscape such as mountains, forest, fields, water, cliffs or a nature journey. Use scale creatively but preserve physical believability. Let category and brand cues decide whether the product is monumental, transported, discovered or embedded in the environment.

commands.label: Miniature Brand World
commands.desc: Tiny people and environments create a story around the product.
commands.instruction: Create one static miniature-world CGI campaign around the exact product. Use tiny people, architecture, tools, roads, food elements or environmental details to tell one clear brand/product story. Maintain believable miniature scale, macro depth of field and purposeful activity instead of decorative clutter.

commands.label: World Inside Product
commands.desc: A complete miniature scene appears inside or through the product form.
commands.instruction: Create one static CGI campaign where a believable miniature world, environment or experience is revealed inside, through or within the visual volume of the current product/package. Preserve the recognizable exterior product form and do not invent technical internals; treat the inner world as a creative campaign metaphor.

commands.label: Character × Product
commands.desc: A human, mascot or fictional-style figure interacts dramatically with product.
commands.instruction: Create one static character-interaction CGI campaign using an appropriate adult human, mascot or clearly fictional generic character interacting with the exact product at an exaggerated scale. The interaction must communicate one simple idea through pose, action and scale. Do not copy a copyrighted character unless the current user supplied or explicitly requested an allowed reference.

commands.label: Giant Hand Interaction
commands.desc: Oversized hand grabs, places, pulls or reveals the product in 3D space.
commands.instruction: Create one static CGI advertising concept using a large realistic hand or controlled human interaction as the main spatial device: holding, placing, pulling, opening, lifting or revealing the exact product. Keep anatomy, contact, shadows and scale believable and use the gesture to tell the campaign idea instantly.

commands.label: Hanging Installation
commands.desc: Product suspended like a premium urban or gallery installation.
commands.instruction: Create one static hanging-product CGI campaign where the exact product is suspended from a building, crane, cable, gallery rig, transport structure or other believable support. Make tension, gravity, contact points, shadows and environmental scale convincing. Avoid simple floating-in-space composition.

commands.label: Product Journey / Transport
commands.desc: Product travels through a memorable branded transport scenario.
commands.instruction: Create one static CGI campaign showing the exact product being transported or delivered through an imaginative but believable system such as cable car, trolley, truck, lift, conveyor, rail or other category-fit journey. Build a clear visual story of movement/delivery without inventing factual logistics claims.

commands.label: Gravity-Defying Campaign
commands.desc: Controlled levitation or impossible balance with strong advertising logic.
commands.instruction: Create one static gravity-defying CGI campaign. Use levitation, impossible balance or suspended elements as a purposeful visual metaphor around the exact product. Maintain convincing object weight, shadow logic, depth and visual balance; avoid the generic centered floating-product template.

commands.label: Surreal Scale Interaction
commands.desc: Huge and tiny objects interact in one believable campaign world.
commands.instruction: Create one static surreal-scale CGI campaign where the exact product interacts with unusually large or tiny everyday objects, people or environments. Use perspective and environmental scale cues so the impossible relationship still feels photographic and immediately understandable.

commands.label: Product Landscape
commands.desc: Brand/product features shape an entire landscape composition.
commands.instruction: Create one static product-landscape CGI campaign where recognizable shapes, colors or packaging features inspire terrain, roads, cliffs, platforms, gardens or environmental forms. Keep the exact hero product present and readable while the surrounding landscape echoes the brand without literally duplicating the label everywhere.

commands.label: Ingredient / Flavor World
commands.desc: Food, flavor or ingredient cues become a rich 3D campaign environment.
commands.instruction: Create one static ingredient/flavor-world CGI campaign using only ingredients, flavors or sensory cues that are visibly supplied or explicitly stated. Build an immersive 3D environment around the exact product using realistic food/material detail, controlled abundance and premium commercial lighting. Never invent ingredients or nutrition claims.

commands.label: Food Story 3D
commands.desc: Dish or beverage becomes a cinematic branded 3D storytelling scene.
commands.instruction: Create one static 3D food/beverage campaign from the current food or drink reference. Turn the hero item into a premium story scene using scale, environment, steam, ingredients, utensils, architecture or people where relevant. Preserve the visible food identity and avoid generic splash-only advertising.

commands.label: Billboard Breakout CGI
commands.desc: Product physically breaks beyond an OOH frame with convincing depth.
commands.instruction: Create one static billboard-breakout CGI campaign. Build a realistic outdoor billboard/display and let the exact product or a product-related element cross beyond the frame using correct occlusion, shadows, perspective and environmental interaction. The effect should feel like a real OOH illusion photographed in place.

commands.label: Anamorphic Display CGI
commands.desc: Forced-perspective 3D screen illusion from one intended viewpoint.
commands.instruction: Create one static anamorphic CGI campaign designed for a single ideal viewing angle. Use forced perspective so the exact product and surrounding scene appear to extend beyond the display volume. Keep screen geometry and product proportions coherent and avoid merely adding anamorphic lens flare.

commands.label: Fake OOH Installation
commands.desc: Surreal branded public installation with photographic realism.
commands.instruction: Create one static fake-OOH campaign where the exact product or a brand-relevant object becomes an impossible but photorealistic public installation integrated into a real place. Use architecture, crowds, streets, weather and environmental scale cues to sell the illusion. Do not reduce it to a normal billboard.

commands.label: Product Event / Activation
commands.desc: Turn product into a premium experiential brand activation scene.
commands.instruction: Create one static CGI campaign showing an experiential activation built around the exact product: pop-up, launch installation, interactive display, event centerpiece or public brand experience. Make the scene commercially plausible, visually bold and clearly tied to the current brand/product.

commands.label: 3D Typography Campaign
commands.desc: Dimensional headline and product become one integrated spatial idea.
commands.instruction: Create one static 3D-typography advertising campaign. Use a short supplied or non-factual campaign headline as dimensional geometry that physically interacts with the exact product through scale, occlusion, contact and depth. Keep the typography highly readable and central to the concept.

commands.label: Liquid Interaction CGI
commands.desc: Fluid becomes an active storytelling device, not a generic splash.
commands.instruction: Create one static liquid-interaction CGI campaign with physically believable fluid behavior around the exact product. Use pours, waves, ribbons, suspended droplets or sculpted liquid only when category-appropriate. Make the fluid part of the campaign idea rather than a generic splash background, and do not imply unsupported ingredients.

commands.label: Material Brand World
commands.desc: Glass, paper, fabric, chrome or organic materials form a brand-fit world.
commands.instruction: Create one static material-driven CGI campaign. Choose one material language that genuinely fits the current brand/category—glass, paper, fabric, metal, foam, clay, wood, stone, translucent plastic or organic forms—and build a spatial world around the exact product. Do not alter the product's own materials unless explicitly requested.

commands.label: Retail / Shelf World 3D
commands.desc: Inventive 3D retail scene turns product display into a campaign concept.
commands.instruction: Create one static premium retail-world CGI campaign where shelving, counters, vending structures, store fixtures, windows or display architecture become part of the creative idea. Keep the exact product accurate and use spatial merchandising in an unexpected, brand-specific way rather than a plain ecommerce shelf.

commands.label: Surprise 3D Campaign
commands.desc: Automatically choose the strongest unexpected commercial CGI concept.
commands.instruction: Create one unexpected static 3D/CGI campaign concept for the current product/brief. First infer the product category, brand cues and likely audience from current visible evidence, then choose one memorable mechanism not already implied by the brief. Prioritize a Pinterest-level commercial idea over material effects, technical visualization or generic product staging.
